cases.name: Modal sacrifice fixture
cases.text:
Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. When you do, choose two —
• Draw a card.
• You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
• This creature deals damage equal to the number of creature tokens you control to target opponent.

cases.name: Sibling target fixture
cases.text:
Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. When you do, choose two —
• This creature deals 2 damage to target player.
• You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
• This creature deals damage equal to the number of creature tokens you control to target opponent.

cases.name: Both modes fixture
cases.text:
Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. When you do, choose one or both —
• Draw a card.
• You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
• This creature deals damage equal to the number of creature tokens you control to target opponent.

cases.name: Required modes fixture
cases.text:
Whenever this creature attacks, sacrifice another creature. When you do, choose one or more —
• Draw a card.
• You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
• This creature deals damage equal to the number of creature tokens you control to target opponent.
